thread.title: Semiconductor Stock Selloff Adds to Monday's Market Woes

author: thestreet.com
title: Semiconductor Stock Selloff Adds to Monday's Market Woes
text:
When it rains it pours and news that Apple Inc. ( AAPL ) is cutting ties with Intel Corp. ( INTC ) as a chip supplier has the entire semiconductor sector looking for shelter.
Bloomberg reported that Action Alerts Plus holding Apple will move on from Intel as a chip supplier for its Mac computers in favor of an in-house model that they produce. The report sent Intel tumbling 9%, its biggest one day drop in nearly two years.
But, Intel wasn't the only security to suffer on the news, the PHLX Semiconductor Sector ETF dropped 4.1% as semiconductor stocks across the board felt the reverberation from Apple's reported moves.
Micron Technology ( MU ) - down 3.93%.
Cirrus Logic Inc. ( CRUS ) - down 4.87%.
Broadcom Ltd. ( AVGO ) - down 3.42%.
Lam Research Corp. ( LRCX ) - down 4.86%.
Applied Materials Inc. ( AMAT ) - down 4.89%.
Qorvo Inc. ( QRVO ) - down 2.91%.
Cypress Semiconductor Corp. ( CY ) - down 4.6%.
Skyworks Solutions Inc. ( SWKS ) - down 3.94%.
ON Semiconductor Corp. ( ON ) - down 4.5%.
Taiwan Semiconductor Co. ( TSM ) - down 2.66%.
Qualcomm Inc. ( QCOM ) - down 3.43%.
